notes.title: Summer Development Update from Drinkbox Studios
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]
As you may know, we [u][url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2974160/announcements/detail/533226373233248985"]announced[/url][/u] Blighted back in June as part of [u][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9JHPGemT0gI&ab_channel=thegameawards"]Summer Game Fest 2025[/url][/u] and [u][url="https://www.youtube.com/live/oEm6wAdqfEY?si=idsgwNISQYIoR5_X&t=2661"]Day of the Devs[/url][/u].  We’re honoured to have been included in those events, and we’re thrilled with the reception the game has received so far![/p][p][/p][p]Since then, we’ve been hard at work…[/p][p][/p][p]We don’t want to spoil too much, buuuut we’ve recently added a TON of new enemies, and we’re still adding more. Each of them are deadly in their own weird and freaky little way...[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcGirw8Xgso8NdeflBw5tE3v9twKbLroA8soxm1P_mNAdGmdkZ5C9_bJyPOj2GZDyuTPcmwgHdYx6G8IqpUKWSmOjzHdpvdjUPkOhc04Oza7_x-x0lJfhnmYhKJKRH3fZxsfhy88A?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"][/img][/p][p]We actually also built out an early version of the entire game as part of an internal-alpha milestone! Now we’re in the process of tearing it up, choosing the best bits, adding new challenges and putting it all back together again.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcB7WNc_ID7rJSXKc1JFCllZP1WG7931zeX0LzGzcbE39r41XNQEUhoFPC5fPW3r2ME0EwTgIr5yNacpA3YQVbiCgsbbN0d3VURjWpuC0UxvbzdqJl4Kz1GFr88HvST0So6Vln-3Q?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"][/img][/p][p]We still have a long way to go, and we’re working on many different aspects of the game, but we’re making steady progress.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdS_wktGXW5cZQpDDjZt3wW6YyMfT8JOuDx3nTPCVZ09bmpu-1zeVOE7mKbCfz3RxLrI_0weblRZDYIhxJnt5lL6L0ZvElUxzM4LaMA6zo8hz-WDj0LxC1uAYI-FOXRAFfLqGL8vg?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We can’t wait to show you more!  If you’d like to follow along, check out the [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2974160/Blighted/"]Blighted store page[/url][/u] and wishlist the game. Thanks for all of your support, it means a lot to us.[/p][p][/p][p]The Drinkbox Team[/p]

notes.title: Announcing Blighted
notes.notes: [p]Hello hello! We have some very exciting news to share!  We'd like to introduce you to [url="https://www.drinkboxstudios.com/games/blighted"]Blighted[/url], a Metroidvania Action-RPG set in a psychedelic western nightmare world, and our most ambitious project to date! [/p][p]Blighted features some of the most intense combat Drinkbox has ever put together, and for the first time in 3D! Time your attacks, read your enemies and capitalize on powerful finishers to survive deadly encounters. Punches will not be pulled![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6863330/b91051b436a2ff35fc887775bb49c7a3be72dd21.gif"][/img][/p][p]We're also excited to debut what we're calling the [i]Blight[/i] system. Tracking skillful plays, the Blight system responds by ratcheting up the difficulty. At higher levels of Blight, enemy behaviors, player abilities and the surrounding environment can all change.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6863330/c9561984667d1dc1ee4c410e45aebed3b78d80b5.gif"][/img][/p][p]Consume the brains of defeated bosses to reclaim lost memories and learn ethereal abilities. Use your newfound powers to complete special challenges and uncover hidden paths.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6863330/466cccfd877be46c7ecf340e8b183e17805cd71a.gif"][/img][/p][p]Featuring music by the acclaimed composer [url="https://jimguthrie.bandcamp.com/"]Jim Guthrie[/url] (who also worked with us on [i]Nobody Saves the World[/i]), jam along to hauntingly beautiful tracks as you play solo, or in co-op!  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6863330/0e3a67165c01a154425f158063acb3c727eeebad.gif"][/img][/p][p]Wishlist the game to get notified when the game launches. Wishlisting also helps boost our Steam launch visibility, so is doubly appreciated.  [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2974160/Blighted/"][/dynamiclink]Finally, please consider [url="https://discord.gg/XXXtbjvx7j"]joining our Discord[/url] to keep up with news and updates about Blighted. Or to just hop in to say hi :)  Thank you all for your support. We can't wait to reveal more about the game soon!  [/p][p]All the best, [/p][p]The Drinkbox Team  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6863330/2cbac35e7efd9c884b9fee3beb6b4858b2510b2f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Upcoming Metroidvania Blighted blends a twisting challenge with the sinister
notes.notes:
Between the Guacamelee series and Nobody Saves the World, Canadian developer Drinkbox Studios has shown that it knows exactly how to make bright and expressive videogame worlds. They're some of my favorites, too, with the original Guacamelee one I consistently return to simply because of how stunning the team's luchador and Mexican stylings are. Well, I'm incredibly glad to report that Drinkbox has done it again, as the team's new game, Blighted, blends incredible visuals with the macabre in ways I never thought possible.
